prestudy.goal: Complete one broad pass through AP concept pages before daily question study begins.
rules: prioritize understanding the concept library over solving daily sets
read Japanese first and reveal Korean only when needed
mark weak concepts for review after daily study starts in October

phases.goal: Establish baseline and cover high-value technology foundations after the September concept-first pass.
rules: teach one focused concept before questions
mix 科目A across multiple topics to expose weaknesses
keep one 科目B scenario every day where practical

phases.goal: Complete broad 科目A coverage including management and strategy.
rules: maintain daily review of technology topics
weekly test includes all three domains: technology, management, strategy

phases.goal: Raise 科目A accuracy and speed to stable passing level.
rules: 科目A receives the majority of daily question time
weak topics and unresolved wrong answers are selected first
weekly timed mixed sets are mandatory
target stable mixed-set accuracy of at least 75% before the exam window

phases.goal: Focus on written reasoning for the selected five 科目B areas.
rules: practice pseudocode, SQL/database reasoning, network troubleshooting, and development-process scenarios
answers must be short, evidence-based, and use terms from the scenario

phases.goal: If study continues, retain practical AP knowledge using weak-topic review rather than full daily exam volume.
rules: use practical system-design and troubleshooting scenarios

daily_selection_algorithm.first: due review and unresolved wrong answers
daily_selection_algorithm.third: current phase topic priority not recently covered
daily_selection_algorithm.avoid: exact question reuse within 90 days unless explicitly presented as review

assessment_rules.wrong: review next study day and re-teach concept if repeated

weekly_test.selection: recent topics + weak topics + wrong answers

monthly_test.selection: full cumulative coverage weighted toward weak areas
